papers.title: AgentSpec: Customizable Runtime Enforcement for Safe and Reliable LLM Agents
papers.role: runtime enforcement DSL over agent actions (closest mechanism)
papers.notes: DSL trigger+predicate+enforce, pre-execution hook; motivating example is a financial transfer. Delta: our deterministic financial-admissibility contract + empirical agreement-not-validity + arithmetic-not-judgment.

papers.title: VeriGuard: Enhancing LLM Agent Safety via Verified Code Generation
papers.authors: Miculicich, Parmar, Palangi, Dvijotham, Montanari, Pfister, Le
papers.notes: Dual-stage: offline synthesize+formally-verify policy, online validate each action pre-execution. Ours is a hand-specified deterministic contract referenced to declared quantities, not LLM-synthesized verified code.

papers.title: Formal Methods Meet LLMs: Auditing, Monitoring, and Intervention for Compliance of Advanced AI Systems
papers.role: LTL trajectory-level compliance monitoring; deterministic >= LLM-judge
papers.notes: TRAC: LTL progression over I/O propositions; offline audit + online monitor + predictor/intervenor. Key result: small-model/deterministic labelers match or exceed frontier LLM judges -> supports our anti-LLM-judge stance. Their unit is the temporal trajectory; ours is single-action admissibility (decidable).

papers.title: ProbGuard: Probabilistic Runtime Monitoring for LLM Agent Safety
papers.notes: Proactive: predicts violations ahead via a DTMC with PAC-style guarantees. Same group as AgentSpec. Ours is deterministic and exact (replayable), not probabilistic prediction.
